description:
Shirahoshi the Mermaid Princess screams for help when she finds a little human, which is Luffy, in her room. He soothes the princess, but then suddenly a giant axe comes flying towards her. Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and Brook are surrounded by the Neptune Army who try to arrest them for a crime they haven`t even committed yet.
Source: Crunchyroll
